description: I'm a CS student passionate about technology, space exploration, and coding. Currently building SPACE COMMAND, a lunar outpost mission simulator for NASA Space Apps Challenge. Looking for enthusiastic teammates interested in web development, React, UI/UX, space science, research, or simulations. No expertise needed—just creativity, curiosity, commitment, and a willingness to learn. Let's build something meaningful together!
summary: SPACE COMMAND – Junior Astronaut Lunar Outpost Simulator is an educational simulation game designed to introduce students to the challenges of sustaining human life on the Moon. Players take the role of Mission Commander, managing a crew of four astronauts over a simulated 30-day mission. The game features five interconnected modules: Life Support, Power Management, Radiation Protection, Food Production, and Lunar Rover Exploration. Through resource management, exploration, and emergency response, players learn how different lunar habitat systems interact. By combining interactive gameplay with educational resources, SPACE COMMAND promotes STEM learning, critical thinking, and awareness of the complexities of lunar exploration.
details:
We propose SPACE COMMAND, an interactive browser-based lunar outpost simulator in which players act as Mission Commander for a crew of four astronauts during a simulated 30-day lunar mission.

The platform integrates five major modules: Life Support, Power Grid, Radiation Protection, Food Production and Greenhouse, and Lunar Rover Exploration. Players monitor resources, make operational decisions, respond to unexpected mission events, and observe how changes in one subsystem affect the entire outpost.

A Mission Control dashboard provides an overview of resources and system conditions, while interactive modules allow players to manage individual systems. The lunar rover introduces terrain exploration, and the mission handbook provides educational explanations. At the end, a mission report helps players evaluate their decisions and mission performance.

Built using React, TypeScript, Vite, and other modern web technologies, SPACE COMMAND aims to deliver an accessible and engaging STEM learning experience.
